purpose: route each local bank physical read/write port only to the module port role that owns that bank

request_protocol.write: valid_ready; one write word is accepted on valid and ready
request_protocol.read: valid_ready request followed by rsp_valid exactly READ_LATENCY cycles after acceptance
request_protocol.request_bank_selection: every module-port request carries a logical bank ID

routing_rules: a request is ready only when its bank ID is in range, the bank is busy, and bank_owner_port equals that physical module-port owner ID
an unowned wrong-owner or out-of-range valid request never enables any physical bank
each physical bank write port receives at most one accepted write request per cycle
each physical bank read port receives at most one accepted read request per cycle
requests from different module ports may be accepted concurrently when they target different correctly-owned banks
GEMM_PSUM may use both physical write port A and physical read port B of its owned bank in the same cycle
the accepted read bank identity and response destination are delayed by READ_LATENCY cycles
read responses are returned only to the module port that issued the accepted request
reset clears response-valid pipelines and fault state but does not own or modify bank ownership state

fault_contract.simultaneous_fault_priority: lowest numeric owner ID then write before read

parameter_legality: BANK_NUM is at least 1 and no greater than 2^BANK_NUM_WIDTH
owner IDs 1 through 5 are nonzero distinct and fit PORT_ROLE_WIDTH

required_cases: MM2S owner 1 write reaches only its selected bank
S2MM owner 2 read returns only to S2MM after three cycles
GEMM ACT owner 3 and WGT owner 4 read different banks concurrently
GEMM PSUM owner 5 reads and writes its bank concurrently
different valid module ports access different owned banks concurrently
wrong owner request is not ready does not enable memory and raises fault
free bank request is blocked and raises fault
out of range bank request is blocked and raises fault
same bank competing accesses cannot corrupt physical routing
reset clears response valid pipelines and sticky fault

downstream: bram_bank or uram_bank physical port arrays

does_not_claim: MM2S or S2MM channel arbitration implementation
